meta.title: Explore the market
meta.description: See current demand, supply, services and commercial activity in global physical-goods trade. No account needed to look.

explore.trust: Public market activity. Look freely; join only when an action needs to be saved or sent.
explore.countsNote: Counts are market records, not verified opportunities.
explore.cappedNote: A count is a floor: this view reads the most recent records, not the whole archive.

universe.title: Explore the market
universe.lead: What is happening in global physical-goods trade right now: what buyers need, what sellers have, and which services are being asked for.

products.title: Products
products.lead: Goods, by sector, using the Ponte product catalogue.
products.empty: No product records are public in this view yet.

services.title: Trade services
services.lead: Freight, customs, inspection, finance and other trade-enabling services members are asking for.
services.empty: No service records are public in this view yet.

distribution.title: Distribution and representation
distribution.lead: Distributors, agents, representation and route-to-market partners.
distribution.empty: Ponte does not classify records as distribution or representation yet, so there is nothing honest to count here. If this is what you need, start a deal and describe it; it is the fastest way to put it in front of the market.

sector.lead: Recent market activity in this sector ({range}), across demand, supply, services and unconfirmed Market Signals.

results.title: Results for {query}
results.lead: Records whose product or geography matches what you searched.

search.label: Search the market
search.placeholder: Search products, markets, companies or services

activity.title: Market activity
activity.lead: Every record shows what it actually is. A Market Signal is an indication Ponte has seen and has not confirmed.
activity.empty: Nothing is public here yet. That is a gap in the market Ponte can see, not the end of the road: describe what you need and it becomes the first record here.
activity.more: Showing the {shown} most recent. Deeper browsing arrives with the sector drill-down.

deal.title: Start a related deal
deal.lead: Source a product, supply a product or offer a trade service. Build and preview it before joining.
